evidence.excerpt: The restaurant-controlled menu hub exposes the current dinner, non-alcoholic drinks, happy-hour share plates, evening specials, and brunch menus with item descriptions.
The Toast storefront linked as Chloe at Home identifies Chloe Navy Yard at 1331 4th Street SE and lists one current Dinner Bundle.
A separately indexed older brunch route contains superseded dishes and naming; it is support-only because the live menu hub carries a newer priced brunch section.
The official homepage identifies Chloe and links its menus, location, and Chloe at Home ordering.
The official location page gives 1331 4th Street SE, Washington, DC 20003, phone 202-313-7007, and current dinner and weekend brunch hours.
An official restaurant-issued seasonal menu tells guests to inform their server about allergies but provides no allergen matrix, ingredient guide, or item-by-item absence claims.
